## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in San Antonio, United States. It starts at 6320 Bandera Road.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Since 2014, San Antonio Aquarium has been inspiring a new generation of oceanic conservationists through education and interactions with incredible sea creatures.
>
> Your San Antonio Aquarium tickets give you access to an underwater kingdom that's home to over 8,000 animals, representing habitats from the shores of Oregon to small Indonesian islands. And it's not just marine animals – the aquarium is also home to lemurs, sloths, reptiles, and more!
